description: The line plot illustrates the training accuracy of three different methods—C³A_b = 128/2, LoRA_r = 1, and Linear—over the course of 400 epochs. The x-axis, labeled "Epoch," is scaled linearly from 0 to 400 with major tick marks at intervals of 50. The y-axis, labeled "Training Accuracy," is also linear, ranging from 0 to 1 with major gridlines at 0.2 intervals. The C³A_b = 128/2 method, represented by a magenta line with a shaded confidence interval, starts at a training accuracy of approximately 0.2 and rapidly increases to a peak of about 0.92 by epoch 50, after which it plateaus near 0.9. The LoRA_r = 1 method, shown as a light blue line, begins at a training accuracy of approximately 0.2 and steadily increases, reaching a value of about 0.8 by epoch 400, with some minor fluctuations. The Linear method, depicted by a solid blue line, starts at a training accuracy of approximately 0.2 and increases more slowly than the other two methods, reaching a value of about 0.8 by epoch 400, also showing some fluctuations. The C³A_b = 128/2 method achieves the highest training accuracy, followed by the Linear method, and then the LoRA_r = 1 method.
